name: Breakthrough Chemistry, Inc.
summary: Breakthrough Chemistry, Inc. is an innovator in the chemical sector, engineering novel compounds and formulations that challenge established industry standards. Leveraging its advanced chemistry platform, the company provides critical solutions across a diverse range of areas. These include enhancing food security and minimizing spoilage, promoting natural resource conservation, improving personal hygiene, crafting protective surface coatings, eliminating unwanted odors, and facilitating chemical neutralization. Based in Bonita Springs, Florida, the organization underwent a rebranding in July 2025, transitioning from its former identity as Megola, Inc. to its current name, Breakthrough Chemistry, Inc.
